goal: Fix record-path overmatching in dwitbuk: record_paths returns bare hunsu and its startswith users hide hunsu.py, hunsu_helper.py and hunsu-notes.md; replace prefix semantics at every record-matching site with exact-file / directory-boundary matching (lock-declared entries included), keep real environment records excluded, sibling directory prefixes as source, and mangsang model records' late-review/source-freshness handling unchanged
brief: Implement the contract in dwitbuk.py and hooks/stop_eyes.py only. Add is_record(path, entries) (Q-match); make record_paths return hunsu's five exact environment files instead of the bare hunsu (Q-hunsu); use is_record at every record-matching site (Q-sites): documents_or_records, verify_packet's touched and excluded filters, source_state's skip and its non-git walk, the eyes request's exclude pathspecs (literal, ':(exclude,literal)ENTRY') and its untracked new_files filter, and the stop hook's dirty filter. Keep mangsang/ in what late eyes read as today, and leave prefixes that are not about record paths alone (Q-keep). test_dwitbuk.py is the contract and is protected: do not edit it, README.md, the manifests, hostcall.py or eyes_worker.py, and do not commit. Run the suite with AGENT_WORKER unset (env -u AGENT_WORKER python3 test_dwitbuk.py): inside a worker session test_session_start_hook_says_what_the_placed_reviews_still_need_and_nothing_else fails only because that hook steps aside when AGENT_WORKER=1.

built.summary: Implemented boundary-aware record matching at all specified sites, exact hunsu environment entries, and literal diff exclusions. Preserved mangsang freshness handling. All 50 tests pass.
non-claims: Changed only dwitbuk.py and hooks/stop_eyes.py; protected tests and pre-existing changes were left untouched.

rp-tests: Q-sites "no record decision is left to `startswith` or to a glob" — no test reads the source; only the outcomes (lookalikes kept, a literal `x[1].json` entry not excluding `x1.json`) are checked, so a different non-prefix rule that gives the same answers would pass.

Q-keep "String prefixes that are not about record paths stay as they are" (packet containment, `--show-prefix` stripping, `run-` names, `eyes*-response.json`, `(provider) `/`settings.` forms, `.local.json`, `../`) — covered only by the existing suite's tests of those behaviours; no new test for each.
Q-keep "`hostcall.py`, `eyes_worker.py`, the manifests and `README.md` are not part of this change; no version bump" — not testable from the suite; a diff review decides it.

Q-keep "`python3 test_dwitbuk.py` passes as a whole, on Python 3.11 or later" — the runner is the check; test_session_start_hook_says_what_the_placed_reviews_still_need_and_nothing_else was already failing before these tests (JSONDecodeError) and is not part of this slice; it was run here only on Python 3.12.

Q-keep tests also assert the exact Q-hunsu `diff_leaves_out` and a hunsu.py staleness check, which is why they fail now; their mangsang, run-record, `reviews/` and packet-directory parts are unchanged behaviour and pass today.
